fetched_title: When the Reward Suite Is Leaky: A Preregistered Causal Contrast of Natural Verifier False Positives in RLVR
summary: Code-test false positives in RLVR are persistent and selected from pre-existing error modes; abstract adds that frontier judges self-assess only weakly on their own false positives (two subjects, MBPP), a same-author test being unresolved. Closest to a same-model self-verification claim but on code, not selected candidates from all-wrong pools.
